2131-2173-4574-5226--44.description:
Sacrifice the templated artifact.
Resolve the ability of your sacrifice outlet.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Arcbound Reclaimer, putting the artifact on top of your library.
Your leaves-the-graveyard effect triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Cast the templated artifact for 0 life through Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.
2131-2173-4574-5226--44.notes:
This combo will only result in creature ETB/LTB/etc. if the chosen card from the template is an artifact creature, in which case creature-specific sacrifice outlets may also be used.
For artifacts from the template that can sacrifice themselves, the free sacrifice outlet is unnecessary.

1349-3899-6012.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature with a coin counter on it.
1349-3899-6012.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the creature with a coin counter on it.
When the creature dies, Athreos's second ability and Reluctant Role Model's ability trigger.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting a coin counter onto itself as well as +1/+1 counters if those were present.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability from step 1.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Reluctant Role Model.
When Reluctant Role Model dies, it and Athreos's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting a coin counter and +1/+1 counters onto the other nontoken creature.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning Reluctant Role Model from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability from step 6.
Repeat.

3967-4275-5003-7892.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four other Elves that do not have summoning sickness.
3967-4275-5003-7892.description:
Activate at least four Elves other than Thranduil by tapping them, adding at least four in any combination of {G} and/or {U}.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Thranduil.
When Thranduil dies, Nim Deathmantle and Faces of the Past trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Thranduil from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Faces of the Past trigger, untapping all Elves and Nobles.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1879-2447-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1879-2447-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Infestation Expert // Infested Werewolf as attackers.
Infestation Expert // Infested Werewolf triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

710-2034-7424.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-3992-7374.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by The Lost and the Damned
1618-2440-3992-7374.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Cyclical Evolution.
Cyclical Evolution triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
The Lost and the Damned triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Cyclical Evolution.
Repeat.
1618-2440-3992-7374.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by The Lost and the Damned. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

2713-3094-4659-7060-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
2713-3094-4659-7060-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {1} due to Zirda and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed, targeting Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine from your graveyard to the battlefield as a 3/3 Robot artifact creature.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-6753-6791.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

3420-7102.description:
Cast False Cure by paying {B}{B}.
Cast Congregate by paying {3}{W}, causing an opponent to gain 2 life for each creature on the battlefield.
False Cure triggers, causing the opponent to lose life equal to twice the life they gained.

2191-4416-5901.notablePrerequisites:
You are able to deal damage to a creature.
Artist's Talent is level 3.
2191-4416-5901.description:
Cast Martyrdom by paying {1}{W}{W}, targeting Phyrexian Vindicator.
Activate Phyrexian Vindicator by paying {0}, targeting a creature.
Attempt to deal damage to the targeted creature. The damage will then be increased due to Artist's Talent, then redirected to Phyrexian Vindicator, which is then redirected back to the creature that was originally targeted.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Vindicator by paying {0}, targeting the creature. 
Repeat step 4 until all damage will be redirected to Phyrexian Vindicator.
Repeat from step 3.

671-2034-2919-3490.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
671-2034-2919-3490.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

339-677-1879-3967.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

225-280-539-6628.description:
Activate PuPu UFO by tapping it, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping PuPu UFO as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.

224-5621-6628.description:
Activate PuPu UFO by tapping it, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping PuPu UFO.
Repeat.

650-2921-6553.easyPrerequisites: Unhallowed Pact attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
650-2921-6553.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

856-1477-2279-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

465-643-1753-3742-4251.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization
Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-1270-2757-3182.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one land card in hand.
You control at least one basic Forest.
392-1270-2757-3182.description:
Activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty by discarding a land card.
Turntimber Sower triggers, creating three 0/1 Plant creature tokens.
Resolve the Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty ability, exiling the top two cards of your library with the ability to play them this turn.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Plant, untapping a basic Forest.
Activate Turntimber Sower by paying {G} and sacrificing the three Plants, returning a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2060-3398-5501.notablePrerequisites:
Crystalline Crawler has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
Ornery Tumblewagg does not have summoning sickness.
Hellkite Charger and Ornery Tumblewagg cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
2060-3398-5501.description:
Activate Ornery Tumblewagg's saddle ability by tapping Crystalline Crawler, causing Ornery Tumblewagg to become saddled until end of turn.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Ornery Tumblewagg's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Declare Ornery Tumblewagg and Hellkite Charger as attackers.
Ornery Tumblewagg's second ability and Hellkite Charger trigger.
Resolve the Ornery Tumblewagg trigger, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability seven times by removing seven +1/+1 counters from it, adding {5}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.
If Crystalline Crawler begins the combo with six or more +1/+1 counters, this combo will net infinite +1/+1 counters on it and colored mana, which will allow you to target any other creature(s) using Ornery Tumblewagg's triggers.

230-1308-3002-4050.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has a card in exile.
230-1308-3002-4050.description:
Activate Void Attendant by paying {1}{G} and putting a card an opponent owns from exile into their graveyard.
The card is instead put back into exile due to Rest in Peace.
Resolve the Void Attendant ability, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Eldrazi Scions, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

337-826-3525-4508.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one artifact.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Amoeboid Changeling and Embraal Gear-Smasher do not have summoning sickness.
337-826-3525-4508.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's first ability by tapping it, causing Embraal Gear-Smasher to gain all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Embraal Gear-Smasher by tapping it and sacrificing an artifact, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token for each opponent dealt damage by Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Repeat from step 2.

376-678-2510-4050.notablePrerequisites:
You control a non-Human creature.
You have a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
376-678-2510-4050.description:
Cast Cubwarden for its mutate cost by paying {W}{W}, targeting a non-Human creature you control.
The Cubwarden mutated creature triggers, creating two 1/1 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Cubwarden mutated creature, adding {W}.
When the Cubwarden mutated creature dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Cubwarden and any cards merged with it from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Cat token, adding {W}.
Repeat.

1495-2744-3334-3828.notablePrerequisites:
Druid's Call attached to Triskelion.
Triskelion has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
1495-2744-3334-3828.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Druid's Call triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Repeat.
During the next player's turn, you may remove all of the +1/+1 counters from Triskelion to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

2034-2308-4506.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2308-4506.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters the battlefield, Auriok Champion triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Auriok Champion trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1722-1818-2034-3583.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1722-1818-2034-3583.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Oloro triggers. Holding prioirty, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Oloro trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

2499-2503-3096.description:
Cast Inverter of Truth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
Inverter of Truth enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice.
Resolve the first Inverter of Truth trigger, exiling your library face down and shuffling your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the second Inverter of Truth trigger, exiling your library face down.
Activate Jace's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing target player to mill two cards and you to win the game due to drawing from an empty library.

23-776-1329-4474.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Orcish Vandal do not have summoning sickness.
23-776-1329-4474.description:
Tap Orcish Vandal, sacrificing Paradise Mantle to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Paradise Mantle.
Cast Paradise Mantle.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1840-3179-3676-4518.description:
Cast False Dawn by paying {1}{W}, drawing you a card.
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {W}.
Oketra's Monument and Tangleroot triggers.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior token.
Resolve the Tangleroot trigger, adding {W}.
Kor Skyfisher enters the battlefield, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.

782-2580-5141.description:
Cast Lethal Vapors by paying {2}{B}{B}.
Activate Lethal Vapors an arbitrarily large number of times.
Cast Teferi's Protection by paying {2}{W}: until your next turn your life total can't change and you have protection from everything.
Allow all the activated abilities from Lethal Vapors to resolve, skipping an arbitrarily large number of turns.
